items.explanation: ちゃ is the colloquial contraction of ては; together with なく it forms なくちゃ, a contraction of なくては, expressing obligation. The final verb (いけない/ならない) remains implicit.

items.jp: 本当に行かなくちゃいけないの？

translation.pt-BR: Você realmente tem que ir?
translation.en: Do you really have to go?

items.label: part of the obligation pattern 〜なくちゃ
items.explanation: ちゃ (= ては) together with なく forms 〜なくちゃ; with いけない it indicates obligation ('have to go').

items.jp: ああ、何て恐ろしい。

translation.pt-BR: Ah, que horror!
translation.en: Oh, how awful!

items.label: part of the exclamatory expression なんて
items.explanation: Este て se junta a 何 e forma 何て, a abertura exclamativa: 'que coisa mais assustadora'.

items.jp: 彼らは毎朝走っている

translation.pt-BR: Eles correm toda manhã.
translation.en: They go running every morning.

items.label: て-form connector
items.explanation: て links 走る to the auxiliary いる, forming 〜ている. On its own it has no translation; it is the piece that builds the progressive/habitual aspect.

items.jp: 窓を閉めてください

translation.pt-BR: Feche a janela, por favor.
translation.en: Please close the window.

items.label: て-form connector
items.explanation: て links the verb 閉める to ください, constructing the polite request 〜てください.

items.jp: 日曜日なので店は閉まっている

translation.pt-BR: Como é domingo, a loja está fechada.
translation.en: Since it's Sunday, the store is closed.

items.label: te-form connector
items.explanation: て links 閉まる to the auxiliary いる, forming 〜ている (resultant state).

items.jp: 電車に乗っている間、ずっと寝ていた

translation.pt-BR: Enquanto estava no trem, dormi o tempo todo.
translation.en: While I was on the train, I slept the whole time.

items.label: te-form connector
items.explanation: て links 乗っ (て-form of 乗る) to the auxiliary いる to form the state 乗っている ("to be on the train").

items.jp: 電車に乗っている間、ずっと寝ていた

translation.pt-BR: Enquanto estava no trem, dormi o tempo todo.
translation.en: While I was on the train, I slept the whole time.

items.label: te-form connector
items.explanation: て links 寝 (て-form of 寝る) to the auxiliary いる to form 寝ていた ("was sleeping").

items.jp: 電気を消してください

translation.pt-BR: Apaga a luz, por favor.
translation.en: Turn off the light, please.

items.label: て-form connector
items.explanation: て links the verb 消す to ください, forming the polite request 〜てください.

items.jp: 彼は読書にひたりきっていた。

translation.pt-BR: Ele estava completamente imerso na leitura.
translation.en: He was completely engrossed in the book.

items.label: -te form connector (links verb to auxiliary)
items.explanation: て is the connector of the -te form that joins ひたりきっ to いた, forming the continuous aspect 〜ている/〜ていた.

items.jp: 彼は当てにしてもいいと思う。

translation.pt-BR: Acho que dá para contar com ele.
translation.en: I believe that he's trustworthy.

items.label: connective て (part of 〜てもいい)

translation.en: He is not in.

items.label: て-form connector
items.explanation: this て links 外出し to the auxiliary いる, forming 〜ています (continuous state/action).
tokens: verbal noun (part of 外出する)

items.jp: 彼は医者として有名だ。

translation.pt-BR: Ele é famoso como médico.
translation.en: He is famous as a doctor.

items.label: component of the ～として pattern
items.explanation: て closes the expression として; together と+し+て form the unit that marks the role.
tokens: part of the fixed pattern ～として

items.jp: ピーマンは半分に切りヘタを取っておく。

translation.pt-BR: Corte os pimentões ao meio e tire o cabinho (deixando pronto).
translation.en: Cut the bell peppers in half and remove the stems (getting them ready).

items.label: て-form connector
items.explanation: て is the て-form of 取る (取って), which links the verb to the auxiliary おく in the structure 〜ておく.

items.jp: 彼の意見は大体において正しい。

translation.pt-BR: A opinião dele está, no geral, correta.
translation.en: His opinion is generally correct.

items.label: component of the phrase において
items.explanation: て closes the fixed expression 大体において; it is not a free connective て, but part of the adverbial phrase 'on the whole.'
tokens: adverb (base of the phrase 大体において)
auxiliary (part of the phrase において)

items.jp: 番号違いにおかけになっているようですよ。

translation.pt-BR: Parece que você discou para o número errado, viu?
translation.en: I'm afraid you have the wrong number.

items.label: te-form connector
items.explanation: て links なる (in the form なって) to いる, forming the progressive ている: "is dialing."
tokens: head of the compound (番号違い = wrong number)

items.jp: 前の席に運転手が座っていた。

translation.pt-BR: Um motorista estava sentado no banco da frente.
translation.en: A chauffeur sat in front.

items.label: part of the てい form (て + いる)
items.explanation: It is the て of the verb 座る, linking it to the auxiliary いる to form 座っていた, the past continuous state: 'was sitting'.

items.jp: 昨日になってはじめて私はそのことを知った。

translation.pt-BR: Só ontem fiquei sabendo disso.
translation.en: Not until yesterday did I know about it.

items.label: te-form connector
items.explanation: て links なる to the rest and is a fixed part of the pattern てはじめて ('only after').
tokens: adverb of time / starting point of になる
verb in て form (part of になってはじめて)
adverb that closes the てはじめて pattern

items.jp: それは私にとって意外な話だった。

translation.pt-BR: Para mim, aquilo foi uma surpresa.
translation.en: It was a revelation to me.

items.label: component of the phrase にとって
items.explanation: て closes にとって together with とる.
tokens: base of the point of view (にとって)
component of the phrase にとって

items.jp: 道はそこで左に曲がっている。

translation.pt-BR: A estrada vira à esquerda ali.
translation.en: The road turns left there.

items.label: て-form connector
items.explanation: て is the て-form of 曲がる (曲がって), which links to いる to form 〜ている (continuous state).

items.jp: この点においてはあなたには同意できません。

translation.pt-BR: Neste ponto, não posso concordar com você.
translation.en: We cannot agree with you on this point.

items.label: part of the phrase 〜において
items.explanation: て completes において; together with に it forms the fixed expression 'in/regarding (this point)'.
tokens: head of the phrase 〜において

items.jp: 静かにしてもらえますか？

translation.pt-BR: Você poderia fazer silêncio, por favor?
translation.en: Could you please be quiet?

items.label: connective て (part of 〜てもらえる)
items.explanation: Links する to the favor auxiliary もらえる, forming the polite request.
tokens: な-adjective (root of the phrase 静かにする)

items.jp: 来週になると、何十万人もの人がその番組を見ているだろう。

translation.pt-BR: Na semana que vem, centenas de milhares de pessoas vão estar assistindo a esse programa.
translation.en: Next week, millions of people will be watching the TV program.

items.label: て-form connector (links 見る to いる)
items.explanation: て turns 見る into its connective form (見て) to join the auxiliary いる, forming the progressive aspect 〜ている ('to be watching').

items.jp: 木がどすんと音を立てて倒れるのが聞こえた。

translation.pt-BR: Deu para ouvir a árvore cair fazendo um baque.
translation.en: The tree was heard to crash to the ground.

items.label: -te form connector (linking actions)
items.explanation: て links 立てる to the following action (倒れる), forming 'fell making noise'; it chains simultaneous/sequential actions.

items.jp: 風は北から吹いている。

translation.pt-BR: O vento está soprando do norte.
translation.en: The wind is blowing from the north.

items.label: te-form connector
items.explanation: て links 吹く to the auxiliary いる, creating 吹いている (ongoing action).

items.jp: 彼女は歌手として有名だ。

translation.pt-BR: Ela é famosa como cantora.
translation.en: She is noted as a singer.

items.label: part of the phrase として
items.explanation: This て (connective) joins し (from する) to close the fixed expression として.
tokens: component of the phrase として

items.jp: 彼女は歌手として名高い。

translation.pt-BR: Ela é célebre como cantora.
translation.en: She is famous as a singer.

items.label: part of the phrase として
items.explanation: て (connective) joins し to complete the fixed expression として.
tokens: component of the phrase として

items.jp: 彼女はあのような時代をやっと生きてきた。

translation.pt-BR: Ela conseguiu, a duras penas, atravessar aqueles tempos.
translation.en: She kept body and soul together in such days.

items.label: -te form connector (links verb to auxiliary)
items.explanation: て joins 生きる to the auxiliary くる, forming the construction 〜てくる ('to have come doing up to now').

items.jp: 彼女は、今度はうまくやろうと心に決めている。

translation.pt-BR: Ela está decidida a se sair bem desta vez.
translation.en: She is determined to succeed this time.

items.label: te-form connector
items.explanation: て links the verb 決め to the auxiliary いる to form ている (continuous state).

items.jp: 彼らは話をしている最中に電話を切られた。

translation.pt-BR: A ligação deles caiu bem no meio da conversa.
translation.en: They were cut off in the middle of their telephone conversation.

items.label: て-form connector (compound verb)
items.explanation: て links する to the auxiliary いる, forming している ('to be doing').
tokens: verb (part of 話をしている)

items.jp: 彼らはチェスをしています。

translation.pt-BR: Eles estão jogando xadrez.
translation.en: They are playing chess.

items.label: て-form connector
items.explanation: this て links the verb し to the auxiliary いる, forming 〜ています, here with the sense of an ongoing action ('they are playing').
